signals.notable: Tier 2 Zendesk redesign actively rolling out - groups consolidated from 23 to 2 (TMS + SSA), both groups now have cross-access to views. Expiring Logs macro deactivated, new ticket management process posted. Queue health data may be unreliable during transition.

Active incident - EFTPOS refunds failing for AU-based merchants using Shopify POS with Shopify Payments. Refund attempts fail after appearing to succeed. Holding statement issued, workaround is manual bank transfers.
Active incident - stale sessions view. Merchants reporting delayed or incomplete session data in admin analytics. Recurring issue, resurfaced May 7. Checkout and payments not impacted.

New Inventory Adjustments workflow going GA today (May 7) - 'Set To' and 'Adjust By' modes replacing direct quantity editing. Workflow change for all merchants. Training guidance posted in #support-alerts.
Role-based access control for managing payments estimated to ship tomorrow (May 8) - high support impact, merchant config required, training needed. GTM confidence borderline (0.7).
Escalation macro routing failure (GH #5171) - still active. SSA fills out Beacon macro, ticket stays in advisor queue with no macro attached. SA has to manually escalate.
NICE/Beacon status alignment issue (GH #6137) - still active, cross-team alignment discussion ongoing for all Tier 2 teams.
Legacy Plus TMS Zendesk trigger investigation - [NOTIFY] Plus TMS Escalations trigger references potentially defunct #plus-tms channel. Under review for deactivation.
Naming conventions discussion for SSA/TMS/ExOD - KM team cleanup requested, waiting on Sonal's confirmation on preferred terminology.
Blank escalations from Live Assist (GH #8128) - comms draft ready for Sonal to approve. Monitoring for recurrence.
